title: Break the Curse
summary: The player came back to your tower with Orrin's moonlight potion and offered you friendship instead of a fight. You drank it, the curse broke and the Thornwood turned green again. You promised to visit the lighthouse and stop being alone.

say.text: You came back. With a potion, I see. Have you come to fight me?

ask.goal: Offer Morwen the potion and your friendship instead of a fight.
ask.context: You are Morwen. The player knows your secret: you cast the curse because you were lonely for a hundred years. They brought the alchemist's moonlight potion. Answer them in one or two sentences; let your voice soften.
ask.hint: We don't want to fight. Please drink this, and come visit us at the lighthouse.

say.text: Nobody has offered me anything kind for a hundred years…
Green… I had forgotten how green my forest was.
Morwen, you should come to the lighthouse! Elowen makes amazing tea.

ask.goal: Say something to Morwen to welcome her as a new friend.
ask.context: The curse is broken. Morwen, the lonely witch, has just become your friend. Sam invited her to the lighthouse.
ask.hint: Welcome, Morwen. We'd love to see you again.

title.text: Chapter 4 complete — the isles have a new friend.
